name: langfuse
description: The Claude-Code Exporter to Langfuse Plugin

LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.title: Langfuse Base URL
LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.description: Langfuse host. Use https://us.cloud.langfuse.com for US, https://cloud.langfuse.com for EU, or your self-hosted URL.

LANGFUSE_USER_ID.title: User ID
LANGFUSE_USER_ID.description: User identifier for Langfuse traces. Defaults to OS account username if not set.

LANGFUSE_TAGS.title: Tags
LANGFUSE_TAGS.description: Comma-separated tags for Langfuse traces (e.g. claude-code,production).

LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS.title: Max content chars
LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS.description: Maximum characters to keep per content field. Default 800000.

LANGFUSE_DEBUG.title: Debug logging
LANGFUSE_DEBUG.description: Write verbose logs to state/langfuse_hook.log. Default true.
